units: viewBox units; each drawing's longer side is 1000

megadrive.title: Mega Drive / Genesis style six-button pad

arcade6.title: Arcade panel: stick and six buttons

neogeo.title: Neo Geo style stick and four buttons

vectrex.title: Vectrex style stick and four buttons

genesis.name: Genesis
genesis.note: Three-button games use A, B, C and Start only.

psx.name: PlayStation
psx.note: Digital-pad games use no sticks; Home is unused.

wii.name: Wii
wii.note: alt: Classic Controller games, drawn as the generic pad.

n3ds.name: Nintendo 3DS
n3ds.note: C-Stick, ZL and ZR exist on the New 3DS only.

colecovision.name: ColecoVision
colecovision.note: No Start, Pause or Reset on the real pad; leave them unlabelled.

androidgames.name: Android Games
androidgames.note: Generic: each game maps its own controls.

namcops2.name: Arcade (Namco 246/256)
namcops2.note: ARMSX2 plays the boards through the PS2 pad.

astrocade.name: Bally Astrocade
astrocade.note: No good match: the real controller is a pistol grip with a trigger and a knob; the one-button joystick stands in.

ebook.name: Book Reader
ebook.note: Not a game system: no controller drawing.

chip8.name: CHIP-8
chip8.note: Its 16-key hex pad is played from the keyboard drawing.

amigacd32.name: Commodore Amiga CD32
amigacd32.note: The CD32 pad: d-pad, four face buttons, two shoulders and Play.

channelf.name: Fairchild Channel F
channelf.note: No good match: the real controller is a twist-and-plunge knob; the one-button joystick stands in.

gw.name: Nintendo - Game & Watch
gw.note: Game & Watch units vary; the generic two-button pad stands in.

cdi.name: Philips CD-i
cdi.note: Thumbpad: d-pad and buttons 1/2 drawn as the generic pad.

pico.name: Sega Pico
pico.note: The Pico is a pen tablet; the generic pad stands in for its buttons.

triforce.name: Triforce
triforce.note: Dolphin maps Triforce games to the GameCube pad.

videos.name: Video Player
videos.note: Not a game system: no controller drawing.

vpinball.name: Visual Pinball
vpinball.note: Flippers and nudges on the shoulders, as Visual Pinball maps them.

supervision.name: Watara Supervision
supervision.note: Landscape on the real unit; same buttons as the Game Boy drawing.
